name: What the Smell During Refinishing Is, and How Long It Lasts
title-tag: The Refinishing Smell: What It Is, How Long It Lasts
meta-description: Waterborne finish smells like wet paint for hours; oil poly fills a house for days and cures for a month. A contractor explains the smell, stage by stage.
post-summary: October 28, 2026 · The refinishing smell depends entirely on chemistry: our ~65 g/L waterborne coats fade to nothing within hours, while 450–550 g/L oil poly fills a house for days and off-gasses through a month-long cure. A stage-by-stage smell timeline, the VOC numbers behind it, and what actually clears the air faster.
